metadata.question: Does the ice cover extent on Lake Erie decrease in January 14, 2014 compared to January 9, 2014?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need to compare ice cover on two specific dates: Jan 9, 2014 vs Jan 14, 2014 - Lake Erie location: approximately 42°N, 81°W - For ice detection, I'll use: * Landsat 8 (operational in 2014) * MODIS Terra or Aqua daily products for better temporal coverage * Sentinel-1 SAR could work but launched in 2014, may not have data - Ice detection approaches: * NDSI (Normalized Difference Snow Index) from optical data * Surface temperature (ice is very cold) * MODIS snow cover products 2. Masking strategy: - Need to see ice/snow, so avoid cloud masking that removes snow - Use QA bands to mask clouds but preserve ice/snow - For MODIS, use the snow cover product directly 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid result: Both dates have images with valid pixels, can calculate ice extent - C1: No images on one or both dates - C2: Images exist but no valid pixels after processing - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN or unrealistic values - A: Ice extent decreased (Jan 14 < Jan 9) - B: Ice extent did not decrease (Jan 14 >= Jan 9) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Lake Erie geometry const lakeErie = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-83.5, 41.3], [-82.5, 41.3], [-78.8, 42.9], [-78.8, 42.9], [-79.0, 43.0], [-81.0, 43.0], [-83.5, 41.8], [-83.5, 41.3]] ]); // Define dates const date1 = '2014-01-09'; const date2 = '2014-01-14'; // Try MODIS Terra Snow Cover Daily const getSnowCover = (date) => { const nextDay = ee.Date(date).advance(1, 'day').format('YYYY-MM-dd').getInfo(); return ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD10A1') .filterBounds(lakeErie) .filterDate(date, nextDay) .select('NDSI_Snow_Cover'); }; const col1 = getSnowCover(date1); const col2 = getSnowCover(date2); const size1 = col1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Jan 9 images: ${size1}`); console.log(`Jan 14 images: ${size2}`); if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { // Try Landsat 8 as fallback const getLandsat = (date) => { const nextDay = ee.Date(date).advance(1, 'day').format('YYYY-MM-dd').getInfo(); return ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(lakeErie) .filterDate(date, nextDay); }; const l8_col1 = getLandsat(date1); const l8_col2 = getLandsat(date2); const l8_size1 = l8_col1.size().getInfo(); const l8_size2 = l8_col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Landsat fallback - Jan 9: ${l8_size1}, Jan 14: ${l8_size2}`); if (l8_size1 === 0 || l8_size2 === 0) { console.log('C1'); return; } } // Process MODIS snow cover const img1 = col1.first(); const img2 = col2.first(); // NDSI_Snow_Cover: 0-100 = NDSI snow cover, 200=missing, 201=no decision, // 239=ocean, 250=cloud, 254=detector saturated, 255=fill // Ice/Snow pixels are those with NDSI_Snow_Cover between 10-100 const getIceMask = (img) => { const snowCover = img.select('NDSI_Snow_Cover'); return snowCover.gte(10).and(snowCover.lte(100)); }; const iceMask1 = getIceMask(img1); const iceMask2 = getIceMask(img2); // Calculate ice extent (area in square meters) const calcIceExtent = (mask) => { const pixelArea = mask.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()); return pixelArea.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: lakeErie, scale: 500, maxPixels: 1e9 }); }; const result1 = calcIceExtent(iceMask1); const result2 = calcIceExtent(iceMask2); const extent1 = result1.get('NDSI_Snow_Cover').getInfo(); const extent2 = result2.get('NDSI_Snow_Cover').getInfo(); // Check pixel counts const count1 = iceMask1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: lakeErie, scale: 500, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDSI_Snow_Cover').getInfo(); const count2 = iceMask2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: lakeErie, scale: 500, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDSI_Snow_Cover').getInfo(); console.log(`Jan 9: Ice extent = ${(extent1/1e6).toFixed(2)} km², Pixels = ${count1}`); console.log(`Jan 14: Ice extent = ${(extent2/1e6).toFixed(2)} km², Pixels = ${count2}`); if (extent1 === null || extent2 === null || extent1 === undefined || extent2 === undefined) { console.log('C3'); return; } if (count1 === 0 && count2 === 0) { console.log('C2'); return; } // Compare ice extents - did it DECREASE on Jan 14 vs Jan 9? if (extent2 < extent1) { console.log('Ice extent decreased from Jan 9 to Jan 14'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Ice extent did not decrease (stayed same or increased)'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
